name: Children's Fairyland
description: Children's Fairyland is a whimsical storybook theme park on the shores of Lake Merritt in Oakland, designed for children ages 0-8. As one of the first theme parks in America, it has delighted families since 1950 with its enchanting sets, live animals, and puppet shows.
fullDescription: Children's Fairyland is a whimsical storybook theme park on the shores of Lake Merritt in Oakland, designed for children ages 0-8. As one of the first theme parks in America, it has delighted families since 1950 with its enchanting sets, live animals, and puppet shows.
whatTheyOffer:
- Fairyland for All: $5 per person with an EBT, SNAP/CalFresh, BIC, or WIC card (up to 8 people per household)
- 510 Fridays: Oakland residents pay $5 for kids and $10 for adults on Fridays (walk-up, with ID showing an Oakland address)
- Military and veterans: $3 off each ticket (up to 6 tickets) with military ID
- Children under 1: Free
- Regular admission: $18 children (ages 1-17), $20 adults, $17 seniors (65+)
- Fairyland for All visitors can also get a discounted membership
howToGetIt: Show your EBT, SNAP/CalFresh, BIC, or WIC card at admission to get the $5 rate for up to 8 people in your household. Buy tickets online or walk up. Open Wednesday through Sunday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., weather permitting.
keywords: Children's Fairyland, Oakland, Lake Merritt, theme park, storybook, kids, EBT $5, WIC discount, Fairyland for All, 510 Fridays, puppet shows
